info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Initiation API
info.description: The Payment Initiation API allows businesses to seamlessly initiate payment transactions within their banking services. By utilizing this API, developers can facilitate the creation of various payment types, enhancing efficiency and user experience. This service is ideal for financial institutions, e-commerce platforms, and any application requiring reliable payment processing capabilities. Typical use cases include processing customer transactions, automating recurring payments, and enabling instant fund transfers. Ensure a smooth payment experience for your customers while integrating robust backend payment workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows the client to initiate a payment. It triggers the necessary processes to start a payment transaction, enabling a seamless payment experience for users.

requestBody.description: This request body initiates a payment process. It is essential to provide all required fields to ensure successful payment initiation.
